UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user settings storing a player's chosen public leaderboard handle.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this profile.

playerName.description: Sanitized public display handle shown on global leaderboards (no PII/email).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

LeaderboardBucket.title: LeaderboardBucket
LeaderboardBucket.description: Parent metadata document for a specific level's global leaderboard.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the level leaderboard bucket was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest recorded leaderboard entry.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A verified player's fastest personal-best clear record for a single level.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

playerName.description: Sanitized public handle displayed on the global leaderboard.

levelId.description: Level number from 1 to 100 matching the parent leaderboard bucket.

bestTimeMs.description: Fastest clear duration in milliseconds (minimum 500ms, maximum 36000000ms).

deaths.description: Number of deaths during the fastest clear run (0 to 100000).

jumps.description: Number of jumps used during the fastest clear run (0 to 100000).

zeroDeath.description: Whether the clear run had zero deaths.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user first posted a time for this level.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the personal-best record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile storing custom leaderboard handle without exposing PII.

/leaderboards/{levelKey}.description: Per-level parent leaderboard document keyed as level_1 through level_100.

/leaderboards/{levelKey}/entries/{userId.description: Per-user fastest clear time entry for a specific level.
